get.description:
Retrieves work queue items with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

      Team Filtering:
      - Without teamId: Shows org-wide queue (or collector's assigned items)
      - With teamId: Shows only items assigned to team members (validated by TeamAccessGuard)

      Behavior:
      - Collectors see only items assigned to them or unassigned items
      - Managers can filter by assignedToUserId to view specific collector queues
      - Returns summary statistics for the filtered queue

parameters.name: assignedToUserId
parameters.description: Filter by assigned user ID (for managers viewing team queues)

parameters.name: searchQuery
parameters.description: Search query for debtor name or account number

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Filter by tags (OR logic - items with any of these tags)

parameters.name: teamId
parameters.description: Optional team UUID to filter work queue by team members

post.description:
Assigns an unassigned work queue item to a specific collector.

      Behavior:
      - Validates that the item is not already assigned
      - Updates the work queue item status to IN_PROGRESS
      - Creates a CollectorResponseTracking record with MANUAL assignment reason
      - Caches assignment data in the work queue item for fast queries

      Permissions:
      - Managers and admins can assign any unassigned item
      - Returns error if item is already assigned (use reassign instead)

400.description: Item is already assigned or validation failed

post.summary: Manually assign work queue item to collector

post.description:
Reassigns an already-assigned work queue item to a different collector.

      Behavior:
      - Validates that the item is currently assigned
      - Validates not reassigning to the same collector
      - Creates a NEW CollectorResponseTracking record (preserves history)
      - Resets contact/response timestamps in the work queue item
      - Updates cached assignment data

      Use Cases:
      - Workload balancing between collectors
      - Transferring accounts when collector goes offline/on leave
      - Reassigning based on collector expertise

      Permissions:
      - Managers and admins only
      - Returns error if item is not currently assigned

400.description: Item is not assigned, reassigning to same collector, or validation failed

post.summary: Reassign work queue item to different collector

post.description:
Assigns multiple work queue items to a single collector in one operation.

      Behavior:
      - Processes each item individually with error handling
      - Continues processing even if some items fail
      - Returns detailed results for each item
      - Maximum of 100 items per request

      Use Cases:
      - Balancing workload across team members
      - Reassigning accounts from collector going on leave
      - Initial assignment of imported accounts

      Permissions:
      - Managers and admins only

200.description: Bulk assignment completed (check individual results for success/failure)

400.description: Validation failed (e.g., too many items, invalid UUIDs)

post.summary: Bulk assign multiple work queue items to a collector

post.description:
Defers multiple work queue items to a specified future date.

      Behavior:
      - Updates status to DEFERRED for each item
      - Sets deferredUntil date for automated reactivation
      - Processes each item individually with error handling
      - Returns detailed results for each item
      - Maximum of 100 items per request

      Use Cases:
      - Deferring accounts awaiting documentation
      - Postponing collection during hardship periods
      - Scheduling follow-up after payment plan setup

      Permissions:
      - Managers and collectors can defer assigned items

200.description: Bulk defer completed (check individual results for success/failure)

400.description: Validation failed (e.g., invalid date, too many items)

post.summary: Bulk defer multiple work queue items to a future date

post.description:
Updates the priority level for multiple work queue items.

      Behavior:
      - Sets the same priority for all specified items
      - Processes each item individually with error handling
      - Returns detailed results for each item
      - Maximum of 100 items per request

      Use Cases:
      - Escalating high-value accounts
      - Prioritizing accounts approaching statute of limitations
      - Adjusting priority based on payment behavior
      - Responding to VIP customer requests

      Permissions:
      - Managers and admins only

200.description: Bulk priority update completed (check individual results for success/failure)

400.description: Validation failed (e.g., invalid priority, too many items)

post.summary: Bulk update priority for multiple work queue items

patch.description:
Marks a work queue item as COMPLETED with a specified resolution type.

      Behavior:
      - Validates item is assigned (cannot complete unassigned items)
      - Validates item is not already completed
      - Updates status to COMPLETED
      - Records resolution in CollectorResponseTracking
      - Calculates days to resolution

      Resolution Types:
      - PAID_IN_FULL: Debt fully paid (also set automatically via payment events)
      - PAYMENT_PLAN: Debtor agreed to payment plan
      - SETTLED: Settled for less than full amount
      - DISPUTED: Debtor disputed the debt
      - TRANSFERRED: Account transferred to another agency
      - WRITTEN_OFF: Debt written off as uncollectible
      - ON_HOLD: Account placed on permanent hold
      - INVALID_DEBT: Debt determined to be invalid
      - STATUTE_EXPIRED: Statute of limitations expired
      - CEASE_AND_DESIST: Debtor requested cease and desist

      Permissions:
      - Collectors can complete their own assigned items
      - Managers can complete any item

400.description: Item is unassigned, already completed, or validation failed

patch.summary: Complete a work queue item with resolution type

patch.description:
Defers a work queue item until a specified future date.

      Behavior:
      - Updates status to DEFERRED
      - Sets deferredUntil timestamp
      - Validates defer date is in the future
      - Cannot defer already completed items

      Use Cases:
      - Awaiting documentation from debtor
      - Postponing during hardship period
      - Following up after promised payment date
      - Waiting for dispute resolution

      Permissions:
      - Collectors can defer their own assigned items
      - Managers can defer any item

400.description: Item is completed, defer date invalid, or validation failed

patch.summary: Defer a work queue item to a future date

patch.description:
Updates the status of a work queue item with business rule validation.

      Supported Status Transitions:
      - NEW: Reset to new/unworked status
      - IN_PROGRESS: Mark as actively being worked (requires assignment)
      - FOLLOW_UP_SCHEDULED: Schedule follow-up (requires followUpDate)
      - DEFERRED: Defer to future date (requires deferUntil)
      - ON_HOLD: Place on hold pending resolution
      - SKIPPED: Mark as skipped by collector

      Note: Use dedicated endpoints for:
      - COMPLETED status: Use /complete endpoint (requires resolution type)

      Business Rules:
      - Cannot mark unassigned item as IN_PROGRESS
      - FOLLOW_UP_SCHEDULED requires followUpDate parameter
      - DEFERRED requires deferUntil parameter
      - Cannot transition to COMPLETED via this endpoint

      Permissions:
      - Collectors can update status of their assigned items
      - Managers can update status of any item

200.description: Work queue item status updated successfully

400.description: Invalid status transition or validation failed

get.description:
Fetches saved views for the current user.

      Returns:
      - User's own saved views
      - Shared team views (if includeShared=true)
      - System quick filters

      Views are ordered by:
      1. Default view first
      2. Alphabetically by name

      Use Cases:
      - Populate saved views dropdown
      - Load user's default view on page load
      - Display quick filter options

      Permissions:
      - All authenticated users can view their own views + shared views

parameters.name: onlySystem
parameters.description: Filter to include only system views

post.description:
Creates a new saved view with custom filters.

      Features:
      - Save any combination of filters
      - Set as default view (auto-loads on page open)
      - Share with team (isShared: true)
      - Include sort configuration

      Use Cases:
      - Save frequently-used filter combinations
      - Create team-wide quick filters
      - Define personal default view

      Examples:
      - "My High Priority": minBalance: 5000, priorityLabels: ['HIGH']
      - "Overdue > 90 Days": minDaysOverdue: 90
      - "New Accounts": status: ['NEW'], sort by createdAt DESC

      Permissions:
      - All authenticated users can create views

get.description:
Returns the user's default saved view.

      Use Cases:
      - Auto-load filters when user opens work queue
      - Restore user's preferred view
      - Quick access to most-used filter set

      Returns null if no default view is set.

      Permissions:
      - User can only get their own default view

200.description: Default view retrieved successfully. Returns null if no default view is set.

get.description:
Fetches a specific saved view by ID.

      Authorization:
      - Must be the view owner, OR
      - View must be shared, OR
      - View must be a system view

      Use Cases:
      - Load specific view details
      - Apply saved filters to work queue
      - Share view URL with team members

      Permissions:
      - View owner, OR shared/system views

patch.description:
Updates an existing saved view.

      Updatable Fields:
      - name: Rename the view
      - description: Update description
      - filters: Modify filter criteria
      - isShared: Toggle team sharing
      - isDefault: Set/unset as default
      - sort: Update sort configuration

      Restrictions:
      - Only view owner can update
      - System views cannot be modified

      Use Cases:
      - Refine filter criteria
      - Share previously private view
      - Update view name/description

      Permissions:
      - View owner only

403.description: Not authorized to update this view

delete.description:
Deletes a saved view.

      Restrictions:
      - Only view owner can delete
      - System views cannot be deleted

      Use Cases:
      - Remove unused views
      - Clean up old filter sets
      - Delete incorrect views

      Permissions:
      - View owner only

403.description: Not authorized to delete this view

patch.description:
Sets a specific view as the user's default.

      Behavior:
      - Clears any existing default
      - Sets specified view as new default
      - User can set any view they have access to as default
        (own views, shared views, or system views)

      Use Cases:
      - Set most-used view as default
      - Auto-load specific filters on login
      - Personalize work queue experience

      Permissions:
      - User must have access to the view (own, shared, or system)

403.description: Access denied - cannot set as default

get.description:
Returns a summary of notifications for the current user.

      Provides:
      - Unread notification count (for badge display)
      - Total notification count
      - 10 most recent notifications

      Use Cases:
      - Display notification badge count
      - Show notification dropdown preview
      - Poll for new notifications (recommended: every 30-60 seconds)

      Permissions:
      - User can only see their own notifications

Fetches notifications for the current user with optional filters and pagination.

      Query Parameters:
      - isRead: Filter by read status (true/false)
      - type: Filter by notification type
      - limit: Max results (1-100, default 50)
      - offset: Pagination offset (default 0)

      Returns notifications ordered by most recent first.

      Use Cases:
      - Display notification list in UI
      - Fetch unread notifications only
      - Implement pagination for large notification lists

      Permissions:
      - User can only see their own notifications

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Maximum number of notifications to return

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of notifications to skip (for pagination)

patch.description:
Updates the read status of a specific notification.

      Use Cases:
      - User clicks notification, mark as read
      - User marks notification as unread for follow-up
      - Decrement badge count when read

      Permissions:
      - User can only update their own notifications

Marks all unread notifications as read for the current user.

      Use Cases:
      - "Mark all as read" button
      - Clear notification badge
      - Bulk notification management

      Returns the number of notifications marked as read.

      Permissions:
      - User can only update their own notifications

count.description: Number of notifications marked as read
